description: The file defines a Java interface 'PolicyEvent' for policy-related events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies methods for retrieving policy identifiers, supported schema versions, resource types, and setting headers. It also includes nested class 'JsonFields' for JSON field definitions related to policies.

classes.name: PolicyEvent
classes.description: A Java interface for all policy-related events, extending the generic Event interface, providing methods for schema version support, policy identification, resource type, and headers. Defines a nested static class for JSON field constants.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array containing JsonSchemaVersion.V_2, indicating the schema versions supported by PolicyEvent.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Deprecated method returning policy ID as a String, based on getPolicyEntityId() method.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId object associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Default implementation returning getPolicyEntityId(), the entity ID of the policy.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'policy'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders for the event, returns the updated event instance.
